title.title: The Scattered Isles of Zvorded
title.subtitle: Being a true & faithful chart of these waters, as surveyed by Reknin the Wayfarer in the year 876 of the Cedar Age

blurb: Gru, the capital. Banners of every vassal hang in its council hall. Guildhalls crowd the square below the citadel. Its founding is set down in the year 435.

reveal.name: Punda
reveal.line: The people of Punda drifted away, leaving only stones to the wind.

clues.text: Today's survey hides one small place, set down on the chart but left unnamed in these notes. Read the lines, then find it.

clues.subject: south
clues.text: It lies in the southern part of the chart.

clues.subject: road
clues.text: A made road comes to its gate.

clues.subject: forest
clues.text: Deep woods stand close about it.
A river runs through its bounds.

events.text: Gru grew from a lone anchorage to a seat of some note.
The standard of The Mak Balka was carried to the borders it holds yet.
Settlers raised the first walls of Vlukkror.
Zodkre was founded in a year the chronicles set down with care.
The Gygid Voivodeship rose to claim the country between the waters.
The Gygid Voivodeship and The Mak Balka fell to war over the border marches.
The Gygid Voivodeship marched against The Tsardom of Sid; the chronicle does not record who prevailed.
Plague and poor harvests emptied Rudugrad; its roofs have since fallen.
The people of Punda drifted away, leaving only stones to the wind.

log.attribution: Being a true & faithful chart of these waters, as surveyed by Reknin the Wayfarer in the year 876 of the Cedar Age
log.summary: The survey is charted: 6 ports set down in the surveyor's hand.

entries.text: Year 843. We set out from Gru, seat of this survey, its walls raised in the year 435. The glass stood fair, and the tide served at dawn.
Year 843. We made sail for Tridzva, a town standing since 469. A fair wind and a following sea carried us in by the forenoon watch.
Year 843. We rode on to Bud, a town standing since 510. A cold rain met us on the last mile, and we were glad of its hearths.
Year 843. We made sail for Svi, a town standing since 522. A stiff breeze served us, and we made the roads before the light failed.
Year 843. We rode on to Tridkran, a town standing since 581. The hedges were white with may, and the air sweet the whole way down.
Year 843. We made sail for Likzvyl, a town standing since 567. We stood in past the shoals on a slack tide, the pilot wary of the reef.
Year 843. We made sail for Gru again, whence we set out, and handed the last of our sail in water we knew by heart.
